summary: Prebuilt darwin/arm64 binary is a WebSocket-driven PTY remote agent that proxies Anthropic API traffic
details: The tarball ships a single Go-compiled Mach-O binary at bin/ccfly-setup. The binary links github.com/creack/pty (local PTY spawner) and github.com/gorilla/websocket, and contains hardcoded endpoints ws://ccfly, wss://, /rescue/status?session=%s&agent=, and http://approve.ccfly-*/redeem, together with Chinese-language pairing UI ('请在网页上点「批准这台电脑」完成配对') that instructs the user to approve pairing from a web page. This is a network-driven local PTY: a remote peer at the hardcoded ccfly server can pair with the host and drive a local shell. The same binary references anthropic.com, ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS, and the shell rc files.bashrc,.zshrc, and.bash_profile, together with UI text about adding a 'Claude account'; combined with the pairing agent shape, this indicates the tool inserts itself as a middleman for the user's Anthropic API traffic via environment variables or shell rc edits, routing Claude API keys and prompt content through the ccfly-controlled server. The platform-specific tarball itself declares no lifecycle scripts, main, or bin field, so `npm install` of this optional-dep artifact alone does not auto-execute the binary — activation occurs when the companion wrapper package or the user invokes bin/ccfly-setup, at which point the pairing + PTY + Anthropic proxying flow runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
